name: Murloc Gills
summary: At Westfall's Longshore, Alba Fairmoon seeks murloc gills to test the sea. She fears the crop blight may reach the Great Sea, and the gills could show whether the coastal waters are tainted.

sections.title: A Threat to the Coastline
sections.body: Westfall is close to ruin. Crops fail, farmers leave their homes, and bandits roam the roads. Alba Fairmoon fears the blight may drain from inland fields into the Great Sea. If it taints the coast, fish that feed Westfall's poor and fill Stormwind City's tables could vanish. Then an already strained kingdom may face famine.

sections.title: Sentinels of Water Quality
sections.body: Murlocs are stubborn and violent, but their amphibious bodies can reveal the water's condition. As they breathe, their gills filter seawater and readily take in poisons, blight, and unnatural pollutants. Alba Fairmoon hopes fresh gills from murlocs prowling the Longshore will show how far the contamination has spread.

faq.q: Why does Alba Fairmoon want murloc gills?
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon wants murloc gills to learn whether Westfall's crop blight has reached the ocean. Their gills filter seawater and can reveal traces of toxins or pollution.

faq.q: Where are the murlocs located for this task?
faq.answer: The murlocs prowl the Longshore, the beach along Westfall's western coast. They haunt the shallows and tidal flats beyond the bluffs.

faq.q: What is the broader danger if the ocean is corrupted?
faq.answer: Westfall is Stormwind's primary breadbasket, and its inland crops are already failing. Coastal fishing provides vital food. If toxins poison marine life along the shore, the kingdom could face famine with no escape.

faq.q: Are murlocs particularly prone to disease?
faq.answer: Murlocs survive harsh conditions, but their amphibious breathing systems react quickly to chemical or magical impurities in the water. That makes them useful for studying waterborne pollution.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood has brought chaos to Westfall and left farmland neglected. Alba Fairmoon's investigation instead examines ecological blight and the protection of the kingdom's food supply.
Alba Fairmoon is an Alliance researcher in Westfall. She monitors the blight and environmental decline threatening the region's farmland.

angles.text: With King Varian missing and food shortages stirring unrest, protecting Westfall's remaining food supply is vital to Stormwind's stability.
Inland blight spreading into coastal waters threatens native wildlife. Watching indicator species such as murlocs helps guard against that danger.
For the people of Stormwind, Westfall's decline threatens their homes, farmland, and dinner tables.
